law_record.title: Bus parking, loading and unloading (A)(4)
law_record.text: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Enter a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or origin or destination point on a public street in such a manner that the bus when stopped to load or unload passengers or baggage shall be in a position with the right-hand front wheel of such vehicle not farther than eighteen inches from the curb and the bus approximately parallel to the curb so as not to unduly impede the movement of other vehicular traffic.

activation_conditions: the subject operates a bus other than a tour bus
it enters a bus stop, bus stand, passenger loading zone or origin or destination point on a public street to load or unload
residue: an eighteen-inch wheel-to-curb distance is at the edge of what a body-extent measurement resolves
summary.subject: bus_operator

timing_requirements.requirement: the position is judged while the bus is stopped to load or unload, not during the entry manoeuvre
the manner of entry is what produces the position, so the approach belongs in the window judged
